meaning:
δι-ανύω
[in LXX: 2Ma.12:17 * ;]
1. to accomplish fully, finish, complete: Act.21:7 (EV).
2. In late writers (Xen., al., Clem., I ad Cor., xxv, 3), to continue: Ac, l.with (Field, Notes, 134f.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais. We greeted the brothers and stayed with them one day.
